supersedes: stage3b_visa_v1 (preserved, frozen — GELU architecture mismatched to its weights)
purpose: STAGE3B VisA 12-class controlled comparison — protocol-matched extension, now with QuickGELU architecture corrected to match the official OpenAI weights. VisA only; no E2 timing claim; PCA residual is an existing method, not a new algorithm; no novelty claims.

authorization.quickgelu_architecture_correction: APPROVED (ChatGPT, 2026-10-23; based on official weight definition, not accuracy)
authorization.visa_gpu_smoke: AUTHORIZED conditionally (ChatGPT, 2026-10-23; gated on CPU tests PASS and user-confirmed GPU price)

dataset.name: visa
dataset.test_split: all test images (good + anomaly); GT masks name-paired within the anomaly split
dataset.mask_convention: name-paired identical basename (.png); NOT the MVTec '_mask' suffix; cross-split name indexing is forbidden (adapter reuses filenames across splits in 5 categories with DIFFERENT content, verified 2026-10-18)

model.name: ViT-B-16-quickgelu
model.official_source: timm/vit_base_patch16_clip_224.openai (Hugging Face repo); open_clip_config.json declares quick_gelu=true; OpenAI CLIP ViT was trained with QuickGELU
model.architecture_correction_reason: The plain 'ViT-B-16' config in open_clip 3.3.0 has no quick_gelu field (GELU default) and pretrained-tag checks only warn; using it with OpenAI QuickGELU weights is architecture-mismatched. v2f uses 'ViT-B-16-quickgelu' which matches the official weight definition (approved 2026-10-23, not based on accuracy).
model.pretrained_source: local offline safetensors ONLY (no network downloads)
model.weights_hash_policy: sha256 MUST equal expected at preflight; mismatch forbids run AND resume reuse
model.feature: 196 patch tokens, D=512, proj applied, L2-normalized
model.legacy_gelu_results: stage3b_visa_v1 (bottle/candle GELU runs) and the legacy 2.24-era VisA historical results are PRESERVED FROZEN; the v1f GELU runs are architecture-mismatched historical reference and must not be blended with QuickGELU results. The legacy open_clip 2.24 VisA results (VNE/Nearest 12-class) were QuickGELU and remain the architecture-compatible historical reference for cross-checks.

primary_analysis.rule: primary configuration was pre-specified before any MVTec/VisA results and MUST NOT be re-selected based on observed results
primary_analysis.mvtec_reanalysis_correction: On MVTec 15-class results, PCA0.99 is NOT uniformly better than VNE-K1: mean pixel AUROC -0.000605 and mean AUPRO -0.005570 vs VNE-K1 (0.90 and 0.97 are positive on both). The earlier phrasing implying all PCA variance settings agree in direction is corrected here; original Stage3A files remain untouched and frozen.

formal_completeness_guard.complete_standard: ALWAYS the frozen 12 categories x 5 chains = 60 unique valid records
formal_completeness_guard.subset_rule: --categories / --category produce PARTIAL runs only; expectations are NEVER relaxed to the run subset
checks: exact chain-set equality per category (missing AND unexpected chains fail)
formal_completeness_guard.partial_policy: partial results retained for recovery but status CANNOT be COMPLETE; final CSV stays *_PARTIAL.csv until 60/60 valid

resume_integrity.data_signature_v2: content-level SHA256 over every normal reference image, every normal test image, every defect test image with its EXPLICIT paired mask (4-tuple), dataset-relative POSIX paths; data_root excluded from the hash (machine-independent)
resume_integrity.no_backfill_rule: if formal records exist but run_fingerprint.json is missing -> resume REFUSED (exit 5)
resume_integrity.non_resume_overwrite: refused (exit 5) when formal records already exist; use a NEW --output-dir
resume_integrity.smoke_formal_isolation: separate output subtrees and distinct markers; smoke records are never read as formal results

normalization_safety.behavior: STOP (SCIENTIFIC_SAFETY_STOP, exit 4); evidence (category/chain/min/max/range) written to SAFETY_STOP_REPORT.json
normalization_safety.outside_01_policy: test normalized scores outside [0,1] are informational counts only, NOT failures

timing_boundary_v2.label: PRELIMINARY_DIAGNOSTIC
timing_boundary_v2.note: same boundary as Stage3A; NOT comparable to frozen Table 3 scorer-only benchmarks; no formal E2 lifecycle claim

resource_guard.wallclock_semantics: cumulative wall-clock (incl. preflight/model setup) checked before each category; breach -> exit 4 WALLCLOCK_BUDGET stop with partial results kept
resource_guard.rmb_budget_note: the pre-approved GPU budget CANNOT be auto-enforced by software; the user MUST verify actual charges in the GPU provider console

provenance.derived_from_runner: stage3a_mvtec_runner_v2_final.py (sha256 353d579d3e321890f71f7784760ebe29968269573811a167565939c9f0008d5d) — copied to a NEW independent file; the original Stage3A runner is unmodified
provenance.stage3a_status: MVTec 15x5 COMPLETE 2026-10-18 (75 records; historical Stage 6 crosscheck PASS); frozen
provenance.visa_historical_reference: results/visa_main_comparison_v1.json (12 classes, 2026-08-06): VNE-K1 mean image 0.82868 / pixel 0.89441 / aupro 0.65378; Nearest mean image 0.85808 / pixel 0.89057 / aupro 0.64138

stop_conditions: non-finite or degenerate normalization (exit 4, evidence kept)
completeness guard failure -> INCOMPLETE (partial kept; never COMPLETE)
any unauthorized GPU/experiment scope -> user stops, reports BLOCKED
